params.body:
Third card, after Deployed and App health, reading the verdicts abovebeyond-ai/elixir#172 writes for this measurement.

- The owner line takes Elixir's `owner` verdict, the gateway line its `gateway` verdict; the per-key rows keep their state word (written by Elixir already) and the card's `keys` facet covers them.
- The PHP rule next to each line (the 7 and 30) stays as fallback for a row written before Elixir judged, and goes in the follow-up once a round has written verdicts everywhere. While the rule decides, the "not yet" Judged line carries no weight.
- One `Judged` line names the thresholds that fired, worst first.

Behaviour on current rows unchanged. Two new tests; suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean. Merge elixir#172 first, or in either order, the fallback covers both.
params.title: The Credentials card reads Elixir's verdict per party
